exposure: epidural sufentanil combined with 0.1% ropivacaine (varying sufentanil dosage)
epidural 0.1% ropivacaine combined with 22.5 mg sufentanil (varying ropivacaine concentration)
outcome: duration of active stage of labor
duration of second stage of labor
cohort: Sixty nulliparous full-term parturients requiring labor analgesia were recruited and randomly divided into two groups.
finding: The EC50 dose of epidural ropivacaine combined with 0.3 mg/mL sufentanil was 0.09687% and the EC50 dose of epidural sufentanil combined with 0.1% ropivacaine was 18.76 mg, both providing satisfactory and safe analgesia with low incidence of side effects.
followup_time: During labor and immediately post-birth (Apgar scores at 1 and 5 minutes)
